constraints: Keep composer.json and composer.lock consistent after removing doctrine/cache, and check that no other package still requires it.
Preserve existing behavior while replacing the abandoned package; review its public API usage before choosing a replacement.

steps.instructions: Remove doctrine/cache from composer.json and replace it with a maintained alternative that fits how the project uses it, then run `composer update`.
steps.title: Replace the abandoned package

verification.purpose: Confirm the Composer project is valid and installs without the abandoned package.
Validate the Composer project and run the PHPUnit suite after the replacement.

rules.summary: Packagist marks doctrine/cache as abandoned and no longer maintained.
rules.title: doctrine/cache is abandoned
